transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in to see me?

I've just been feeling persistently depressed and really sad for a very long time now. It has been going on like this constantly for about two years and four months. I just can't seem to shake this heavy, down mood.
Have you had any period of at least two months during the past two years when your mood felt normal or back to your usual self?

No, I haven't had any period like that at all. This heavy sadness and depressed mood have been completely constant and continuous for the entire two years and four months. I haven't felt like my normal self for even a few weeks, let alone two months.
